ALPINE-CVE-2026-4738 (zlib 1.3.2-r1) is in the pinned golang:1.27-alpine base image; no upstream digest ships the fixed zlib 1.4-r0 yet. The Dockerfile installs zlib>=1.4-r0 during the build and fails if that version is unavailable, but Nox inventories the base image, not the built one. Remove this entry when the FROM digest moves to an image with zlib >= 1.4-r0.
